description: Unbiased scan for the most basic surface patch anywhere in the MKSR-1 B9 domain, compared with calcium-dependent and calcium-independent C2 domains

import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def parse_pdb(txt, model=1):
    out=[];cur=1
    for line in txt.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur=int(line.split()[1])
        if cur!=model: continue
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
            except (ValueError,IndexError): continue
            out.append(dict(rec=line[:6].strip(),name=line[12:16].strip(),alt=line[16],
                 resn=line[17:20].strip(),chain=line[21],resi=int(line[22:26]),
                 xyz=xyz,bfac=float(line[60:66] or 0)))
    return [a for a in out if a["alt"] in (" ","A")]

def af(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60)
    return r.text
def pdb(i):
    return requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{i.upper()}.pdb",timeout=60).text

TIP={"LYS":"NZ","ARG":"CZ","ASP":"CG","GLU":"CD"}
def patch_scan(atoms,chain=None,lo=None,hi=None,plddt=None,radius=12.0):
    """For every residue centre (CB, or CA for Gly), count charged side-chain tips within radius.
    Returns list of (resn,resi,pos,neg,net) sorted by net descending."""
    sel=[a for a in atoms if a["rec"]=="ATOM" and (chain is None or a["chain"]==chain)]
    if lo is not None: sel=[a for a in sel if lo<=a["resi"]<=hi]
    if plddt is not None: sel=[a for a in sel if a["bfac"]>=plddt]
    centres={}
    for a in sel:
        if a["name"]=="CB" or (a["name"]=="CA" and a["resn"]=="GLY"):
            centres[a["resi"]]=(a["resn"],a["xyz"])
    tips=[(a["resn"],a["resi"],a["xyz"]) for a in sel if a["resn"] in TIP and a["name"]==TIP[a["resn"]]]
    out=[]
    for resi,(resn,c) in centres.items():
        p=n=0; mem=[]
        for tn,ti,tx in tips:
            if np.linalg.norm(tx-c)<=radius:
                mem.append(f"{tn[0]}{ti}")
                if tn in ("LYS","ARG"): p+=1
                else: n+=1
        out.append((resn,resi,p,n,p-n,mem))
    return sorted(out,key=lambda r:-r[4])

targets={}
targets["MKSR-1 (AF Q21191, 7-203)"]=(parse_pdb(af("Q21191")),None,7,203,70)
targets["B9D1 human (AF Q9UPM9)"]=(parse_pdb(af("Q9UPM9")),None,1,9999,70)
targets["PKC-alpha C2 (3gpe_A)"]=(parse_pdb(pdb("3gpe")),"A",None,None,None)
targets["Syt1 C2A (3f05_A)"]=(parse_pdb(pdb("3f05")),"A",None,None,None)
targets["PTEN C2 (1d5r_A, 186-351)"]=(parse_pdb(pdb("1d5r")),"A",186,351,None)

rows=[]
for nm,(at,ch,lo,hi,pl) in targets.items():
    sc=patch_scan(at,ch,lo,hi,pl)
    top=sc[0]
    allnet=np.array([r[4] for r in sc])
    rows.append((nm,top[0],top[1],top[2],top[3],top[4],float(allnet.mean()),top[5]))
    print(f"{nm}")
    print(f"   most basic patch centre: {top[0]}{top[1]}  +{top[2]} / -{top[3]}  net {top[4]:+d}")
    print(f"   domain mean net charge per 12 A patch: {allnet.mean():+.2f}   (n residues {len(sc)})")
    print(f"   patch members: {', '.join(top[5])}")
print()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,3.6))
nms=[r[0] for r in rows]; nets=[r[5] for r in rows]; means=[r[6] for r in rows]
y=np.arange(len(nms))
cols=["#c0532a","#c0532a","#2b6ca3","#2b6ca3","#777777"]
ax.barh(y,nets,color=cols,height=0.55,label="best 12 A patch")
ax.plot(means,y,"kd",ms=7,label="domain mean patch")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(nms,fontsize=8.5); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge within 12 A (Lys+Arg minus Asp+Glu)")
ax.set_title("Best basic surface patch anywhere in the domain",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump([[r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3],r[4],r[5],r[6]] for r in rows],open("patchscan.json","w"))
